summary: Frontend-only UI revision verification for iteration 3. All 6 revision items validated on desktop (1920x800, 1400x900) and mobile (360x780, 390x844). Hero height reduced to 698px on desktop (was full viewport). about-years-badge removed. Tools letter badges are uniform 32x32px. related-projects section removed. Embla-based project gallery slider works (next/prev/dots/counter/loop/drag). No horizontal overflow on mobile at any scroll position for Home and Project Detail. Mobile menu opens with 5 visible links. Admin login (admin/Admin@12345) works and /admin/projects loads without 'Maximum update depth' errors. Regression checks pass: project cards navigate to detail, contact email CTA present.
critical_code_review_comments: Public pages call /api/auth/me and produce console 401s for unauthenticated visitors — not a bug but noisy; consider skipping the call on public routes or suppressing 401 logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 UI revisions all verified passing. Detailed measurements: hero desktop=698px height; tools badges all 32x32; gallery counter progression 01→02→03→01 (loop) works; dot active width 32px vs inactive 8px; mouse drag 300px advances slide. Mobile innerWidth=scrollWidth at scroll positions 0,500,1500,3000,5000(,8000) on both Home and /projects/toko-rasa-ecommerce. Admin auth still functional. Only observation: /api/auth/me returns 401 for public visitors — pure console noise, non-blocking.
